goal: Systematic author audit of every object-combination and symbol/section-resolution entry path consumed by U1/R1.
coverage_contract: Complete path x listed ELF case-class matrix, using bounded executed regressions plus code-level identity/refusal proofs. proven_safe means the stated decision property is safe under the existing independent gates, not blanket acceptance of every containing ELF or a claim of independent review.

paths.proof: All canonical symbols are retained; extra SYMTAB/DYNSYM, noncanonical allocated-relocation tables and unsupported section indices are recorded and rejected by the v14 entry guard.
Placement sections and zero-size dependency sections are separate views, not namespace filters; nonallocated and special-index definitions remain in the symbol inventory.
Positive and zero-size section IDs are disjoint, actual owners survive, and header indices are remapped without treating opaque/nonallocated targets as external symbols.

paths.path: Symbol scope and pre-combination reference provenance
paths.proof: Every symbol gets an original-object scope and every relocation keeps its pre-binding reference. Nested combination cannot turn an undefined local into a legal global reference.
Every defined symbol of every binding/kind/storage enters the namespace; COMMON and invalid extents explicitly refuse rather than being omitted.

Only legal global/weak undefined references bind. Conflicting or unproved duplicate definitions refuse; equal ABS identities are equal values and supported COMDATs still require downstream complete-copy proof.
Locals remain direct scoped identities and never resolve a foreign global extern. Named undefined locals, incompatible reference kinds and unsupported supplied target kinds refuse.
The same non-mutating namespace cutover runs before every v14 link, even without extra objects. Section IDs/ownership stay unchanged for reporting.

paths.path: Function/global placement views and entry aliases
paths.proof: Filtered placement views are not absence proofs. Borrowed aliases require a full-sized sibling at the same entry/ISA; complete namespace and extent validation precede these views.
Canonical/proposed/per-link names cannot manufacture a supplied definition or erase one. Original-bound names cannot receive candidate-only removal; unknown weak addresses do not guess zero.
All allocated roots and zero-size witnesses participate; full metadata and typed LINK_ORDER/INFO_LINK targets are retained and validated.

Eligible code must satisfy the full entry/body/ABI proof and contain only permitted function aliases, local section symbols and ARM markers. Independent data/file/global-section aliases refuse removal.
A complete sole D0 identity, same-object D1, explicit original table and all binding/extent/mapping exclusions remain mandatory after namespace normalization.

paths.path: Unwind entry keys, tails and personality namespace
paths.proof: The ABI exception requires genuinely undefined global/weak NOTYPE/FUNC, zero value/size, default visibility and no supplied same-name definition of any binding/storage. Own keys/tails remain exact structural edges.
Censuses consume resolved symbol identities and every allocated source. Only exact independently proven structural companion edges leave the census; direct and companion cycles refuse.
Complete section/group metadata, resolved targets, visibility and symbols must agree; equal local names/addresses/bytes do not merge distinct sections. Both orders retain the same required proof.

paths.path: Placement, data inference, L1 and BSS verification
paths.proof: Namespace normalization cannot infer placement for zero/nonallocated/COMMON storage. Emitted data/BSS and independently selected L1 pools retain their existing full extent, original-witness and equality conditions.

paths.path: Final target and NONE dependency resolution
paths.proof: ABS uses its actual value, genuine undefined externs use explicit original bindings, and every supplied NONE dependency needs verified placement. COMMON/zero/nonallocated definitions cannot silently become library externs.
Rewrites consume the resolved target and retain strict original-body/full-local-body equality, call ABI and ARM CFG constraints; no omitted definition can masquerade as external.

Resolved clones preserve original section IDs and owner labels. Surviving comparisons, unique credited ownership and complete object/harness/input hashes remain mandatory; all actions reach reporting consumers.

namespace_policy.locals: Preserved and scoped, never used to satisfy a cross-object global extern. Any supplied local personality spelling conservatively denies the ABI exception.

namespace_policy.nonalloc: Symbols remain in the namespace even though nonallocated sections are not output-placement sources. References cannot masquerade as external definitions; unsupported target placement refuses.
namespace_policy.duplicates: No order-selected weak/global winner; only proved COMDAT identity or equal full ABS values can proceed.
namespace_policy.legacy: Filtered placement/global views remain unchanged for old models; v14 alone performs the complete non-mutating cutover.
